rules.rule: User-visible strings in packages/ui/src/native/** must use useSdkTranslation() with t('key') or <Trans i18nKey="key">. Add every new key under reactnative.* in platform-localization (sources/common/en.json); synced locale JSON arrives via the Distribute React Native Localization workflow. Flag any newly added or changed user-visible English literal in Text children, accessibilityLabel, accessibilityHint, placeholder, alert/Alert strings, and SDK-owned headerTitle values — not just known examples like Cancel, Loading, Books, or Versions. Do not flag packages/ui/src/dom/** (ADR 0019), __tests__/**, *.test.*, consumer-provided prop pass-through, or non-user-facing literals (test IDs, log messages, style tokens, route names). See docs/contributing/native-i18n.md.

Translation JSON under packages/ui/src/i18n/locales/ (en.json, es.json, fr.json, and any future locale) is generated and synced from the platform-localization repo. Do not hand-edit these files or add/change/remove string values directly in a PR. New keys must be added under reactnative.* in platform-localization (sources/common/en.json) and arrive via the 'Distribute React Native Localization' workflow. Flag any diff that adds or edits string values in these files. Exception: the automated localization sync PR. locales/index.ts is auto-generated via pnpm generate:locale-index — flag hand-edits that do not match the codegen output.

Web SDK components mount only inside an Expo DOM wrapper. A 'use dom' file outside packages/ui/src/dom/** is a finding. Allowed DOM entries are bible-reader.tsx, bible-text-view.tsx, and footnote-content.tsx. packages/ui/src/native/register-dom-impls.ts may register those entries. Native code may import Web SDK values.

Layer-3 tests swap DOM, NativeSheet, and sibling sheets through stubImpl, setImpl, and getImpl from packages/ui/src/test-utils/install-test-impls.tsx. Those helpers call setImpl on the registry in packages/ui/src/native/component-impls.ts. Tests assert the bridge with latestDomProps. They do not mount 'use dom' in RNTL and they do not jest.mock app modules. packages/ui/jest.setup.js may shim native runtimes only.

A new package export is a finding unless packages/ui/src/__tests__/exports.test.ts or a core exports test already pins it. Allowed exports keys are "." and "./package.json" on both packages, plus "./sdk-version" on core only, per ADR 0011. UI primitives stay on packages/ui/src/components/ui/ and off src/index.ts.
